Remark
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0082 1. Remark 3.8\group variation-formulas

The scalar curvature variation can also be written invariantly as \[ \partial _t R=-\Delta H+\operatorname {div}(\operatorname {div} h)-\langle h,\Rc \rangle . \]
